ueno-2012.citation: Ueno et al. (2012), Modification of a Kenai eddy along the Alaskan Stream, JGR 117, C08032.
ueno-2012.access: Original author-hosted published PDF retained; actual pages 2, 3 and 6 reviewed for methods, split/absorption chronology, narrative quantities and Figure 5 context.

records.source_locator: Section 2 paragraph 8 and section 3 paragraphs 9-12, PDF pages 2-3; Figure 5 caption, PDF page 6.
records.scope: One source-named Kenai 2006 main track, not a regional climatology. The label continues through a February 2009 split; Kenai 2006a is a separate child.
records.qualification: Source-case reference, not a regional constant or full intact-parent lifespan. The main track is not merged with the Kenai 2006a child; no child values inherited. Source links the summer 2007 observations to Rovegno et al. (2009), but OSW does not create a new physical identity join or duplicate this evidence into the separately catalogued published 2007 case. No diameter, radius, footprint, annual extrema or seasonal animation inferred.
